nodes.value: After another key is released (better for typing)

nodes.label:
Decides when a dual-role key counts as a hold if another key is pressed. Rules can override this default in advanced options. Chord detection is configured separately.

After another key is released: the key becomes a hold once another key is pressed and released while it is down, or when the hold threshold passes. Fast rolls while typing stay taps.

As soon as another key is pressed: useful for dedicated layer or modifier keys. Reacts faster, but overlapping letters while typing can trigger the hold by mistake.

A second tap within this time after the first release counts as a double tap.

A single tap on a key with a double-tap action runs only after this window ends, so a large value makes such keys feel slow. Keys without a double-tap action are not delayed.

Standard value: 200 ms.
